Hi Grace and Ben,

Thanks for the conversation last week — the team at NimbusWorks is very interested in a short, executive-friendly demo of Redwood Inference focused on predictable latency and cost controls. Our CIO (Laura Mendez) and VP of Platform Ops want a concise walkthrough aimed at decision criteria rather than a deep technical dive.

Can you offer 45 minutes that include a quick customer-story, the platform guardrails (SLAs, dedicated/private options), and a Q&A for the execs? Preferable windows this month (all times UTC):
- Mon Dec 13, 16:00–16:45 UTC
- Wed Dec 15, 16:00–16:45 UTC

If neither works we can propose alternatives — CIO availability is limited so we want to lock something soon. Also let me know which of your folks would be best to have on the call (CTO/VP level coverage vs solutions lead).

Thanks,
Kyle

Head of Cloud Infrastructure
NimbusWorks

Kyle — thanks for the note and for looping us in. Happy to run an exec-focused session; goal will be decision-readiness (45 minutes recommended):
- 5 min: intros + objectives
- 15 min: brief product story + guardrails (SLA, routing/fallbacks, private options)
- 15 min: short demo of scored examples (latency/cost tradeoffs)
- 10 min: Q&A / next steps

We have availability for the Dec 15 slot and can hold Dec 13 as backup. Proposed presenters: myself (partner-facing solutions), Ben Carter (sales/contract lead) and one of our engineering leads on standby if a deep technical question comes up. If you want the CIO-level conversation to skew to architecture, please mark that in the attendee list — otherwise we’ll keep the narrative focused on business outcomes and procurement guardrails.

I attached a short briefing/agenda (RDW-exec-demo-agenda.pdf) to help set expectations and timeboxes. Could you confirm: 1) preferred slot, 2) final attendee list (name + title), and 3) any non-negotiable topics (security, data residency, costing model)?

If you prefer I can send a calendar hold once you confirm. Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
